⚡️🇺🇸🇷🇺🇺🇦 [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/27/us/politics/cia-director-russia-ukraine.html): CIA Director John Ratcliffe privately delivered a bleak assessment of Russia's war against Ukraine to FSB chief Aleksandr Bortnikov, urging Moscow to pursue a peace deal before its military and economic position deteriorates further. 
Ratcliffe told Bortnikov that Russia has gained only about 1% of Ukrainian territory in the 18 months since he became CIA director, attributing the stalled advance to Ukraine's success in drone strikes, and previously noted that a Russian soldier's life expectancy on the front lines is under 35 minutes. 
Before the meeting, Ratcliffe consulted his Ukrainian counterparts to assure them he would be probing Russian positions rather than negotiating on Kyiv's behalf. The visit marks the first face-to-face meeting between Ratcliffe and Bortnikov, following an earlier prisoner swap they had coordinated remotely. 
Direct US-Russian intelligence-chief meetings have been rare in recent years, as the last one was CIA Director William Burns' November 2022 meeting with SVR chief Sergei Naryshkin in Ankara, where Burns warned against Russian use of a nuclear device in Ukraine.
European diplomats believe a window for a peace agreement may open this winter given Russia's stalled Donbas offensive and Ukraine's continued ability to inflict costs through drone strikes, with some pressing Washington to add a dedicated national security official to the negotiating track.
